purpose: Event-level audit of genuinely new pre-match absence information that became public after the real Crown T12 source event. This is research only; no production rule or Gate.

events.first_public_signal: 2026-10-11 morning UK, team-hotel footage showed Szoboszlai absent; exact original social-post UTC not recovered
events.multi_source_confirmation: Liverpool official team news / independent matchday reporting around 14:15-16:03 UTC
events.evidence_note: Friday pre-match build-up did not name Szoboszlai as an injury doubt; Sunday morning hotel footage created the first public signal. Liverpool later confirmed he was out with a hamstring issue.
events.R61_reported_absence_before_news: not counted as a reported injury in the Guardian snapshot

events.evidence_note: Friday Everton coverage kept team news quiet and a pre-match projected XI still included Grealish. Everton's matchday statement then said he missed the Arsenal match through sickness.
events.R61_reported_absence_before_news: 0 Everton reported unavailable in Guardian snapshot

events.evidence_note: He was in line to face United, then developed fever/illness. Matchday reporting and the team sheet confirmed the absence; BBC attribution states Alonso said he was ill and had fever.
events.R61_reported_absence_before_news: not the late new absence; Guardian snapshot did not capture this matchday illness

events.first_public_signal: 2026-10-31 matchday; exact first public timestamp not recovered
events.multi_source_confirmation: Leeds Live/Beren Cross reported pain in Friday final training; independent matchday lineup sources confirmed he was absent
events.evidence_note: Farke said Friday that Okafor had trained normally and was fully available; he then felt recurrent adductor pain during Friday's final session and missed Bournemouth.
events.R61_reported_absence_before_news: not counted in the Guardian Friday snapshot as an injury

events.first_public_signal: 2026-10-25 matchday; exact first public timestamp not recovered
events.evidence_note: Friday/previous-day Leeds projections still had Elvedi in the back three and reported no new Leeds problems; he was then ruled out through illness on matchday. Exact first-public minute remains unresolved, so this stays below the four high-confidence events.
events.R61_reported_absence_before_news: not counted as an unavailable Leeds player in the Guardian snapshot

next_required_fields: whether T24 snapshot formed before or after the new absence
conclusion: Four events are high-confidence genuine new absences after T12; one additional event is probable but lacks an exact first-public timestamp. The key unresolved variable is the exact Crown T24 formation/receipt timestamp. Without it, T24 price movement cannot be treated as a tradable response to the new information.
